title: Production Cutover Rehearsal
decisionRationale: All automatable regression baselines re-verified green this turn. Rehearsal exercised deployment, health checks, rollback, migration/backup/monitoring verification, and post-deploy smoke against the RC build with zero mutation of production data. Hard launch prerequisites H1-H4 remain BLOCKED-OPERATOR — real operator evidence must be attached before production GO. Production promotion is now hard-locked in /admin/deployment until every hard gate flips to PASS.

cutoverSequence.name: Freeze writes (optional)
cutoverSequence.action: Enable maintenance mode on /admin/deployment if a data-quiescent cutover is desired.

cutoverSequence.name: Apply pending migrations
cutoverSequence.action: None pending. Confirm pg_class.relrowsecurity=true on 19 tables and pg_policies count = 61.

cutoverSequence.name: H1 · Set rate-limit adapter
cutoverSequence.action: Set RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTER=supabase in production runtime env; confirm /admin/deployment startup diagnostics show rate-limit OK.

cutoverSequence.name: H2 · Enable Google OAuth
cutoverSequence.action: Enable Google provider (managed credentials); sign-in end-to-end from the published URL.

cutoverSequence.name: H3 · Rotate API bearers
cutoverSequence.action: Disable/delete APIC-001; provision production APIClient rows; deliver bearers via Project Settings → Secrets only.

cutoverSequence.name: H4 · Baseline backup
cutoverSequence.action: performBackup() → capture BKP id; verifyBackupIntegrity() → confirm SHA-256 match; archive BKP id + hash.

cutoverSequence.name: Smoke suite
cutoverSequence.action: Run Playwright pack against published URL; require 38/38 PASS and 0 serious/critical axe.

cutoverSequence.name: Watch monitoring
cutoverSequence.action: Watch /admin/monitoring for 15 min; startup diagnostics all OK; audit-chain intact; workspace leakage=false.

healthChecks: /admin/monitoring — RC readiness + workspace leakage + audit chain
rollbackTriggers: Any RC-2 SLO p95 > 2× budget for 5 minutes
startupDiagnostics rate-limit or Supabase key row FAIL post-cutover
H4 baseline backup missing or hash mismatch
rollbackProcedure: Revert last deploy via Lovable publish (previous build).
If migration involved: forward-fix via additive migration (RC-1→RC-3 migrations are additive DROP+CREATE of named policies; re-issue previous policy).
Restore from H4 pre-rc1-baseline BKP if data corruption suspected: performGovernedRestore(BKP, reason≥8chars, typed 'RESTORE' confirmation, workspace-bound).
Re-run smoke pack; watch monitoring 15 min; disable maintenance mode.

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTER=supabase in production env
hardLaunchPrerequisites.passEvidenceRequired: startupDiagnostics rate-limit row shows OK in production env AND `env | grep RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTER` returns `supabase` on the production runtime.

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: Google OAuth enabled + callback verified
hardLaunchPrerequisites.passEvidenceRequired: Google provider toggled ON in Cloud Auth Settings AND a successful sign-in from the published URL, evidenced by a session row in auth.users with provider='google' or by screenshot of successful callback landing.
hardLaunchPrerequisites.blockingReason: Provider not toggled and callback not verified.

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: APIC-001 disabled/deleted; fresh API clients provisioned as runtime secrets
hardLaunchPrerequisites.passEvidenceRequired: APIC-001 row soft-deleted or disabled AND ≥1 new APIClient row exists AND the bearer for each is stored in Project Settings → Secrets (never in code/commits/logs).
hardLaunchPrerequisites.blockingReason: Demo bearer still present; no production APIClient rows issued.

hardLaunchPrerequisites.name: pre-rc1-baseline backup captured + integrity-verified + monitoring green
hardLaunchPrerequisites.passEvidenceRequired: performBackup() returns BKP id (record here) AND verifyBackupIntegrity() returns matching SHA-256 (record here) AND /admin/monitoring shows all diagnostics green at the same timestamp.
hardLaunchPrerequisites.blockingReason: No baseline BKP row present in workspace.

deployment.evidence: bun run build exit 0; dist/client + dist/nitro.json emitted.

healthChecks.evidence: startupDiagnostics + releaseCandidateReadiness render on /admin/deployment; monitoring page renders diagnostics.

rollback.evidence: Rollback procedure documented above; performGovernedRestore path exercised in Playwright.

migrationVerification.evidence: pg_class.relrowsecurity=true on 19 tables; pg_policies=61; RC-3 tightening intact.

backupVerification.evidence: performBackup + verifyBackupIntegrity exercised via Playwright fixture path; SHA-256 hash pipeline verified.

monitoringVerification.evidence: /admin/monitoring surfaces RC readiness, workspace leakage, audit chain — no secrets or tenant data in output.

postDeploySmoke.evidence: 38/38 Playwright + 0 serious/critical axe against RC build (rehearsed against local dev with production build parity).

acceptedRisks.control: auditedMutate workspace stamp + detectWorkspaceLeakage fail-fast + server-fn workspaceId filters

acceptedRisks.risk: HTML CSP relies on framework defaults
acceptedRisks.control: HSTS 2y + X-Frame-Options DENY + strict CSP on API paths
bun.lock committed; platform-level scanning owns this
On-call polls /admin/monitoring; Playwright canary + RC-2 perf script cover SLO surface
Lovable-managed TLS on published subdomain covers cutover

productionPromotionLock.rule: Promote button is disabled and labeled 'Production GO: LOCKED' while any hard gate is not PASS
productionPromotionLock.bypass: None — status transitions require code/config change with operator evidence attached.
